news/solfipe-produk-inovasi-pipa-pe-seba.title: SOLFIPE, PGN SOLUTION'S PE PIPE PRODUCT, IS A COMMITMENT TO SUPPORT GAS NETWORK DEVELOPMENT
news/solfipe-produk-inovasi-pipa-pe-seba.body:
PGN Solution, a subsidiary of Pertamina Gas Negara, demonstrates its commitment to supporting the development of a secure, efficient, and durable gas network infrastructure. In this context, the selection of connection materials and pipes is a crucial factor that significantly affects operational costs (OPEX) and overall project success. PGN Solution addresses this challenge with its flagship product: Solfipe.

Solfipe, which stands for Electrofusion Fitting and Pipe Solution, is an integrated solution specifically designed for polyethylene (PE) gas piping systems. It is made from Medium Density Polyethylene (MDPE 80) in yellow and High Density Polyethylene (HDPE 100) in orange—both featuring exceptional characteristics suitable for applications such as home connections and main distribution pipelines for City Gas, Natural Gas, LPG, and Biogas networks.

The Solfipe product has obtained the Indonesian National Standard (SNI), Lemigas Certification, CIQS 2000:2018, and ISO 9001:2015, with a Domestic Content Level (TKDN) of 25% for MDPE 80 Pipes and 48% for HDPE 100 Pipes.

Why Choose Solfipe for Your Project?

  • Flexible: High ductility, lightweight, and strong—making it the optimal pipe choice.
  • Crack Resistant: Manufactured from Polyethylene material that offers high resistance to cracking.
  • Lightweight: Easy to transport and install.
  • Corrosion Resistant: Made from non-corrosive Polyethylene material.
  • Varied Connection Methods: Offers multiple convenient options for pipe connection.
  • Weather Resistant: Manufactured from Polyethylene that withstands extreme weather conditions.
  • Abrasion and Sedimentation Resistant: The smooth internal pipe surface minimizes abrasion and sediment buildup.
  • Long-Term Use: Polyethylene pipes are designed with a lifetime of more than 50 years.

Solfipe is available in various sizes to suit your project needs. (See below for detailed Solfipe size specifications.)

Not only for gas pipelines, Solfipe’s High Density Polyethylene (HDPE 100) product type can also be used to support Fiber Optic Network Distribution projects.

With Solfipe, PGN Solution not only delivers a high-quality product but also strengthens its role as a strategic partner in supporting national energy resilience and developing reliable and environmentally friendly natural gas infrastructure. We are committed to continuously providing solutions and meeting future challenges.

Head of the K3PL and Security Division of PGN Solution Astrid Taruli Debora said "This food truck has been installed such as a stove, water heater, generator, cupboard coolers, dispensers, rice cookers, microwave ovens, irons and gas dryers. "This beach clean-up activity is expected to raise awareness of all parties to be able to protect and maintain environmental sustainability, especially from plastic pollution and other pollutants," said Astrid Taruli Debora.

news/pipeline-patrol-wilayah-sumatera-se.title: PIPELINE PATROL SOUTH SUMATRA REGION
news/pipeline-patrol-wilayah-sumatera-se.body:
PGAS Solution South Sumatra region conducting Pipeline Patrol as a series of PGN pipeline patrols specifically done around pipes through inspections within ROW (Right of Way). This routine and scheduled pipeline patrol is conducted to maintain pipeline safety and reliability as PGN vital asset. It is called a vital asset because 70% gas that PGN sold goes through this pipeline.

Carrying out pipeline patrols in the ROW some planning and preparation are done such as, setting the goal plan and equipments necessary. For example, a patrol is done KP 127+800, KP123+000 etc, this line determines the vehicle route and the type of equipments to bring, and gathering information en route. Information includes and not limited only on “hot gossip” on route such as community issues, any wild animals, etc. Once information is gathered, then the necessary actions will be taken in addition to regular deforestation, anoda measuring, and coordinate checks.

Patrol routes are generally difficult to access. Some might have to go through a small river, some might be through rice fields that are prone to getting stuck as well as going through rocks which makes excellent driving skills necessary for the safety of natural gas distribution in South Sumatra West Java (SSWJ) pipeline.

Activities carried out by personnel during patrol includes: Socializing with the locals en route is crucial because by doing this, we will receive information on activities around the pipeline such as road widening plans, land dispute conditions, planting plans, even including forest fires etc.


Shrubs and tree clearings clearing is crucial because the more shrubs especially those with single and deep roots might indirectly disturb pipe conditions in the ground. In dry seasons there is potential for wildfires to spread. Other than those factors, to support the next patrol, tall bushes might interfere officers in monitoring the pipeline.

news/pgas-solution-kembali-turunkan-petu.title: PGAS SOLUTION HAS SENT METER REGISTRARS TO CONSUMER’S HOME
news/pgas-solution-kembali-turunkan-petu.body:
PT. Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk adalah is a Gas Subholding part of Pertamina Group is been trusted to develop natural gas infrastructure and improve natural gas utilization. PGN continuously grows and develop various infrastructures that are able to support energy needs in various sectors. Such as the ones in Sidoarjo - Mojokerto area, PGN penetrated various sectors starting from industries to household and small consumers. Until today as many as 6631 households and small consumers are recorded as having experienced good energy by PGN.

In order to improve consumer satisfaction, PGN has done many ways so consumers experienced the comfort in using PGN natural gas. With GasKita, a PGN natural gas product for household and small consumers running through the gas pipeline network, PGN ensures that all households may feel the warmth of natural gas. Through PT PGAS Solution, PGN subsidiary company, is committed to maintain reliability in good energy distribution. One of PGAS Solutions efforts in providing service to consumers is by recording gas meters monthly.

Recording household gas meter done by PGAS Solution personnel on a specified schedule monthly so there not be any drastic burst of usage from each consumer. However, with the spread of Covid-19 recently there has been a couple of adjustments and regulations made by PGN in order to maintain the level of quality as well as consumer service quality during the Covid-19 emergency. PGN removed recording gas meters by registrar during April- Mei 2020. With no manual meter recording, PGN decided to implement independent meter recording for all household and small consumers by sending a photo to a specified whatsapp number or downloading an Independent Recording Meter app in PlayStore.

Entering June 2020, PGAS Solution from PGN has recorded meters directly to household and small consumers. Officers has again visited door to door for the sake of accuracy and appropriate use of good energy by consumers. The meter reading of natural gas is carried out while following the Guidelines of Covid-19 Prevention and Control by wearing standard Personal Protective Equipment. Moreover, PGAS Solution also ensures officers are in good health throughout the meter recording process.


Although officers are back checking the stand meter directly, PGN also reminds consumers to use online services in recording the meter independently through whatsapp or an application on PlayStore. Not only recording, PGN consumers are also able make natural gas bill payment online through ATM, Internet Banking, SMS Banking, E-Wallet apps such as Link Aja, Gopay etc, and even E-Commerce apps such as Tokopedia, Bukalapak, and the sort. Moreover, PGN consumers may also maximize PGN services through PGN Contact Center 1500645, for bill information, new connections, reinstallation, installation change as well as consumer complaints.

press-release/pgn-solution-perkuat-kerja.title: PGN SOLUTION STRENGTHENS COLLABORATION WITH THE DIRECTORATE OF METROLOGY TO SUPPORT RELIABLE GAS MEASUREMENT THROUGH GAS METER VERIFICATION AND REVERIFICATION
press-release/pgn-solution-perkuat-kerja.body:
Bandung, October 29, 2026 – PT PGAS Solution signed a Cooperation Agreement with the Directorate of Metrology regarding the verification and/or reverification of gas meters and their associated equipment. The signing ceremony, held at the Directorate of Metrology Office in Bandung on Thursday (October 29), marks a strategic step toward strengthening collaboration and supporting the reliability of gas measurement systems through the utilization of calibration facilities that comply with metrological standards.

The event was attended by PGN Solution's Director of Operations, Agoeng Pratomo Noegroho, the Head of Operation Project, the Head of Calibration and Instrumentation SOR II, and their accompanying teams. The agreement aims to facilitate the utilization of calibration equipment owned by PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGN) for the verification and/or reverification of turbine gas meters and their associated equipment.

PGN Solution's Director of Operations, Agoeng Pratomo Noegroho, emphasized that this collaboration represents an important step toward improving the quality and reliability of gas measurement through the utilization of calibration facilities that meet metrological standards.

"Through this collaboration, we hope to optimize the utilization of calibration facilities to support gas meter verification and reverification activities. This initiative reflects PT PGAS Solution's commitment to continuously improving measurement reliability, maintaining accuracy, and supporting safe operational activities in accordance with applicable standards," said Agoeng.

Through this partnership, the calibration facilities are expected to be utilized more effectively to support testing processes and ensure the accuracy of gas measuring instruments in accordance with applicable metrological regulations. This initiative also forms part of the company's efforts to enhance service quality and maintain measurement reliability in supporting operational activities within the energy sector.

With the signing of this Cooperation Agreement, PT PGAS Solution reaffirms its commitment to strengthening collaboration with stakeholders, enhancing the reliability of calibration and gas measurement services, and supporting safe, accurate, and sustainable operations in the energy industry.

press-release/pgn-solution-raih-platinum.title: PGN SOLUTION RECEIVES PLATINUM AWARD AT THE INDONESIA ANNUAL REPORT AWARD (IARA) 2026
press-release/pgn-solution-raih-platinum.body:
Jakarta, October 23, 2026 – PGN Solution has once again achieved recognition by receiving the Platinum Award at the 5th Indonesia Annual Report Award (IARA) 2026, organized by Economic Review. The award recognizes the quality of PGN Solution's 2025 Annual Report, which achieved a score of 93.75, earning an A (Very Excellent) rating and a 5-Star ranking in the Subsidiary of State-Owned Enterprises – Assets > IDR 2 Trillion category.

The award ceremony was held on Friday, October 23, 2026, at the 2nd Floor Auditorium of the National Library of the Republic of Indonesia, Central Jakarta. Under the theme “Sustained Transparency: Building Trust, Driving the Future,” with a focus on ESG, sustainability reporting, and Good Corporate Governance (GCG), the event recognized companies that demonstrate excellence in corporate reporting and the implementation of transparency and accountability principles.

The awards were evaluated by an independent panel of judges based on seven key criteria, including compliance with Financial Services Authority (OJK) regulations, quality of financial reporting, sustainability disclosures, innovation and development of sustainable financial products or services, sustainability governance, report presentation and publication, and the utilization of corporate social and environmental responsibility funds.

PGN Solution's Corporate Secretary, Mr. Haryoga A. Wardhana, stated that the award serves as motivation for the company to continuously enhance the quality of its reporting and corporate governance practices.

“This award serves as both recognition and motivation for PGN Solution to continuously improve the quality of its reporting and strengthen the implementation of Good Corporate Governance. We believe that transparency and accountability are essential foundations for building stakeholder trust and supporting the company's long-term business sustainability,” said Mr. Haryoga.

This achievement reflects PGN Solution's ongoing efforts to strengthen the implementation of Good Corporate Governance (GCG) principles while continuously improving the quality of transparent and accountable corporate reporting to support sustainable business growth.

press-release/pt-pgas-solution-dukung-ke.title: PT PGAS SOLUTION SUPPORTS RELIABLE GAS MEASUREMENT THROUGH THE FIRST OPERATION OF A TURBINE AND ROTARY PISTON METER CALIBRATOR
press-release/pt-pgas-solution-dukung-ke.body:
Jakarta, October 7, 2026 – PT PGAS Solution, together with PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (Persero) Tbk, conducted the first testing and operation of the Turbine and Rotary Piston Gas Meter Calibrator using the Sonic Nozzle measurement standard at Calibration and Instrumentation SOR II, Klender, East Jakarta. This activity forms part of the effort to enhance the reliability and accuracy of gas measurement systems while supporting compliance with applicable metrology standards.

The procurement of the new calibrator was driven by the existing calibrator, which has been in operation for 15 years and handles more than 1,700 tests annually. In addition, approximately 51% of testing flow rates use a G.65 Master Meter with a 2-inch (DN50) size, while around 41% of Turbine and Rotary Meters installed at SOR II customers are of the same diameter. These conditions highlighted the need for more advanced calibration technology with a high level of accuracy, particularly for low-flow testing.

The calibrator uses a Sonic Nozzle Test Bench as its measurement standard, with a capacity of 1–100 m³/hour, atmospheric air as the testing medium, and an accuracy level of ±0.25% FS. The equipment has also obtained the Sonic Nozzle Test Bench Verification Certificate Number 3838/025/EX/06/2026 from the Legal Metrology Standards Management Center.

Director of Operations of PT PGAS Solution, Mr. Agoeng Pratomo Noegroho, stated that the presence of the new calibrator is an achievement that the company can take pride in, as it is expected to support testing needs over the long term.

“We should be proud of the presence of this calibrator. In addition to being utilized over the long term, this facility also strengthens our gas meter testing capabilities so that testing can be carried out more reliably and in line with operational needs. As the party responsible for carrying out and managing its operation, we would like to express our appreciation for the support and collaboration of all parties involved in bringing this facility into operation,” said Mr. Agoeng.

The new calibrator is expected to help reduce the workload of the existing calibrator, particularly for DN50 (2-inch) Turbine and Rotary Meters, while maintaining the reliability of the measurement system and supporting timely calibration in accordance with applicable regulations.

The first operation was attended by General Manager Sales and Operation Region II of PT PGN (Persero) Tbk, Iwan Yuli Widiastanto; Group Head Project Management Office of PT PGN (Persero) Tbk, Raka Haryo Indro; Director of Operations of PT PGAS Solution, Agoeng Pratomo Nugroho; Director of Finance and Business Support of PT PGAS Solution, Ariadi; and Division Head Operation Management and Support of PT PGN (Persero) Tbk, Imron. Also in attendance were Head of the Measuring Instruments Testing Center, Directorate of Metrology, Ministry of Trade of the Republic of Indonesia, Dr. H. Ade Haryanto, S.T., M.T., Ph.D.; and Head of the Legal Metrology Standards Management Center, Directorate of Metrology, Ministry of Trade of the Republic of Indonesia, Aris Kusnandar, S.T., M.T.

The event was marked by a ribbon-cutting ceremony to officially open the Turbine and Rotary Piston Gas Meter Calibrator Laboratory, followed by the symbolic first operation of the calibrator and the first application of the official verification mark.

The operation of this calibrator forms part of PT PGAS Solution’s efforts to support gas measurement systems that are reliable, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards.

press-release/pgn-solution-dan-nusantara.title: PGN SOLUTION AND NUSANTARA REGAS STRENGTHEN SYNERGY IN SUBSEA PIPELINE EMERGENCY RESPONSE PREPAREDNESS
press-release/pgn-solution-dan-nusantara.body:
Jakarta, September 8, 2026 – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) and PT Nusantara Regas signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation for Emergency Response Preparedness for PT Nusantara Regas’ Subsea Pipeline System at Wisma Nusantara, Jakarta.

The MoU was signed by President Director of PT Nusantara Regas, Mohd. Iskandar Mirza, and President Director of PT PGAS Solution, Sonny Rahmawan Abdi. The collaboration marks an initial step toward strengthening joint preparedness to support operational safety, environmental protection, asset reliability and integrity, as well as the continuity of gas supply.

Under this collaboration, PGN Solution will contribute its expertise in operations and maintenance, engineering, inspection, construction, and technical services for energy infrastructure. The cooperation also covers the exchange of technical data and information, assessment of personnel readiness, competencies, equipment, materials, and other resources, as well as the enhancement of communication and coordination mechanisms in responding to emergency situations.

President Director of PGN Solution, Sonny Rahmawan Abdi, emphasized that effective emergency preparedness requires strong collaboration supported by reliable resources and capabilities.

“Emergency preparedness requires not only a rapid response, but also strong coordination, capabilities, and resource readiness. Through this collaboration, we expect PGN Solution’s capabilities to complement those of Nusantara Regas in maintaining safety, asset reliability, and operational continuity,” said Sonny.

The scope of cooperation also includes technical and operational assessments, risk analysis, drills and tabletop exercises, the establishment of roles and responsibilities, as well as resource mobilization mechanisms required to strengthen emergency response preparedness.

The MoU serves as an initial framework for PGN Solution and Nusantara Regas to strengthen coordination and develop more detailed cooperation mechanisms through a Cooperation Agreement (PKS) or an Emergency Repair Agreement, reflecting both companies’ shared commitment to enhancing preparedness, safety, asset reliability, and the operational continuity of energy infrastructure.

press-release/pgn-solution-tampilkan-ino.body:
Tangerang, June 5, 2026 – PGN Solution participated in the Pertamina Patra Niaga Infrastructure Downstream Experience (PINDEX) 2026, held by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga at ICE BSD Hall 10, Tangerang, from Wednesday (June 3) to Friday (June 5).

PINDEX 2026 is the first downstream engineering innovation event organized by Pertamina Patra Niaga. The event serves as a platform to showcase technology, infrastructure, and developments in the downstream energy sector in support of national energy resilience and self-sufficiency.

This year, PINDEX 2026 featured 73 exhibitions from companies and brands in the technology, energy infrastructure, and strategic partner sectors, both national and international. The event also provided a space for collaboration among business players, service providers, industry partners, and the public to gain a closer understanding of the development of Indonesia’s downstream sector.

The booth also served as a platform for PGN Solution to engage directly with visitors, business partners, and industry players regarding the need for reliable and sustainable energy solutions.

On this occasion, PGN Solution introduced several flagship products, including SOLBRATION, a diaphragm gas meter calibrator for residential customers that is independently produced; SOLFIPE, consisting of polyethylene pipes and fittings for gas distribution network systems; SOLFUSION, a solution for PE pipe jointing and leakage handling; and ELECTION, a non-contact AC electric field detector designed to support occupational safety.

With an informative, attractive, and representative booth concept, PGN Solution together with SENA successfully received the Best Booth Platinum award at PINDEX 2026. This award serves as an appreciation of the company’s efforts in presenting product and service information in a relevant and engaging way for visitors.

Interim President Director of PGN Solution, Mr. Ariadi, stated that PGN Solution’s participation in PINDEX 2026 is an important step in demonstrating the company’s role in supporting the strengthening of the national downstream energy ecosystem.

PGN Solution hopes that its participation in PINDEX 2026 can strengthen the company’s position as a strategic partner in engineering, operation, and maintenance, while supporting the development of reliable, sustainable, and competitive energy infrastructure solutions.

Jakarta, May 20, 2026 – PGN Solution continues to strengthen its commitment to supporting the development of national energy infrastructure through the Phase 1 Household Natural Gas Network (Jargas) Development Project in Cirebon Regency in collaboration with the Directorate General of Oil and Gas, Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM).

press-release/rupst-2025-pgn-solution-pe.title: RUPST 2025: PGN SOLUTION STRENGTHENS PERFORMANCE FOUNDATION AND BUSINESS TRANSFORMATION DIRECTION
press-release/rupst-2025-pgn-solution-pe.body:
Jakarta, April 24, 2026 – As part of its commitment to implementing Good Corporate Governance (GCG) principles and evaluating corporate performance, PT PGAS Solution held its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGMS) for Fiscal Year 2025 at the Open Space Room, 2nd Floor, Building C, PGN Office Complex, Ketapang, West Jakarta. The meeting was attended by the shareholders, namely PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (Persero) Tbk and Yayasan Kesejahteraan Pegawai dan Pensiunan Gas Negara (YKPP), along with the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors of PT PGAS Solution.

During the meeting, the shareholders approved the Company’s Annual Report for Fiscal Year 2025 and ratified the Financial Statements for Fiscal Year 2025, including granting full release and discharge of responsibilities (acquit et de charge) to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for their management and supervisory actions carried out during the fiscal year. The meeting also approved the allocation of net profit for Fiscal Year 2025, the appointment of a Public Accounting Firm (KAP) to audit the Financial Statements for Fiscal Year 2026, as well as the determination of salaries or honorariums for Fiscal Year 2026 and remuneration for Fiscal Year 2025 for the Company’s management. In addition, the AGMS approved amendments to the Articles of Association and changes to the composition of the Company’s management.

In relation to these changes, the AGMS resolved the end of tenure for members of the Board of Directors in accordance with the provisions of the Articles of Association. The Company expressed its appreciation for the contributions and dedication that had been given.

President Commissioner of PT PGAS Solution, Mr. Barito Mulyo Ratmono, stated that the AGMS serves as an important forum to ensure the Company remains aligned with good governance principles and sustainable strategic direction. “Through this AGMS, we ensure that every decision is not only oriented toward short-term performance, but also strengthens the Company’s foundation in facing future business challenges,” he said.

Representing PT Perusahaan Gas Negara (Persero) Tbk, Mr. Hery Murahmanta emphasized the importance of synergy in driving the Company’s performance. “The Company is expected to consistently prioritize occupational health and safety, encourage positive business growth, and strengthen effective risk monitoring and mitigation. The Board of Directors together with the Board of Commissioners must also ensure that every investment program is supported by thorough planning. In addition, optimizing tax issue resolution, receivables management, and cash management is essential to maintaining financial performance. Synergy within the Subholding Gas environment, follow-up actions on audit findings, as well as the implementation of Good Corporate Governance principles in every business process, including cooperation with third parties, must continue to be maintained to support the sustainability of the Company’s performance,” he stated.

This AGMS forms part of the Company’s governance mechanism in ensuring sustainable performance and the continuity of its future business strategy. PT PGAS Solution remains committed to conducting its business professionally, transparently, and accountably, while delivering optimal added value to shareholders and stakeholders.

press-release/green-solution-sinergi-den.title: GREEN SOLUTION: SYNERGIZING WITH THE ANANDA WOMEN'S FARMERS GROUP (KWT), PGN SOLUTION CREATES GREEN SPACES FOR COMMUNITIES AROUND GAS NETWORK ASSETS
press-release/green-solution-sinergi-den.body:
Tangerang – PGN Solution is implementing a Green Solution Program in the form of Potted Fruit Plants (Tabulampot) as part of the company's commitment to the environmental CSR pillar and as an effort to improve the safety of operational asset areas. This program is being conducted at the Keroncong Permai Housing Complex, RW 14, and involves the local community, particularly the Women Farmers Group.

The Tabulampot Program was initiated as a solution to organize the area around PGN's Meter Regulating Station (MRS) and Box Valve assets, which have been covered by residents' plants, hampering maintenance, and other operational activities. By rearranging the plants in Tabulampot, the asset area can be managed more orderly and safely, while still providing environmental benefits to the community.

PGN Solution hopes that the collaboration fostered through this CSR program will serve as a foundation for harmonious relationships and provide tangible benefits to the surrounding community and environment.

press-release/pertamina-gas-negara-bersa.title: PERTAMINA GAS NEGARA AND PGN SOLUTION STRENGTHEN GOVERNMENT COMMITMENT BY DELIVERING CLEAN ENERGY FOR THE COMMUNITY
press-release/pertamina-gas-negara-bersa.body:
Jakarta – The government continues to encourage the use of clean and sustainable energy to support national energy security while also improving community welfare. One of the concrete steps being taken is the development of Household Gas Networks (Jargas), which are believed to provide strategic benefits such as expanding energy access, creating jobs, and strengthening the economy.

As part of its support for this initiative, Pertamina Gas Negara together with PGN Solution signed a framework contract for the construction of natural gas networks (Jargas) for households, small customers, and commercial industries. The event took place at the Multimedia Room, Building A, 1st Floor, PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk Head Office, and was attended by the Board of Directors of Pertamina Gas Negara, the Board of Directors of PGN Solution, the Head of the Downstream Oil and Gas Regulatory Agency, Ms. Erika Retnowati, A.K., M.Si., as well as representatives from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources.

The signing was carried out by the Director of Strategy and Business Development of Pertamina Gas Negara, Ms. Rosa Permata Sari, and the President Director of PGN Solution, Mr. Sabaruddin. This agreement represents a tangible form of synergy between the government and state-owned energy enterprises to accelerate the realization of Jargas development in priority regions.

The planned Jargas infrastructure development will be implemented in Surabaya–Gresik and the Batam Distribution Network Area (WJD) during the 2025–2027 period. Specifically for Batam City, the area has been designated as a pilot project for the overlay between LPG and Pertamina Group’s Jargas, as part of the government’s efforts to strengthen the utilization of natural gas for the community.

In his remarks, President Director of PGN Solution, Mr. Sabaruddin, emphasized, “PGN Solution is fully committed to supporting the government’s efforts in expanding the use of natural gas for the community. Through the development of Jargas, we are ready to deliver cleaner, more efficient, and sustainable energy, strengthening national energy security and supporting Indonesia’s energy transition targets. We believe the benefits of this program will be increasingly tangible for the community through strong collaboration with the government.”

Through this initiative, Pertamina Gas Negara together with PGN Solution reaffirm their full support for government policies in delivering more accessible, safe, and sustainable environmentally friendly energy. The development of Jargas is expected not only to reduce carbon emissions but also to strengthen national energy independence for a greener and more competitive future for Indonesia.

press-release/solmetsos-kolaborasi-inova.body:
Jakarta, May 22, 2025 – A strong collaboration between PGN Solution and SOR 2 of PT PGN Tbk has resulted an outstanding achievement by winning the Gold Award at the Annual Pertamina Quality Award (APQA) 2025, an event organized by PT Pertamina (Persero) and held at Hotel Borobudur, Jakarta, on Monday, May 19.

Representing the Gas Subholding, PGN Solution, together with the PC-PROVE WORKSHOP KINGDOM X SOR 2 team, presented a solution that successfully prevented revenue losses of more than IDR 4 billion during the replacement of measurement equipment at the PLN Indonesia Power Cilegon Gas Station, PT PGN Tbk SOR 2. The innovation ensured accurate measurement and continuous reliability in natural gas distribution to customers.

The APQA is an annual awards program organized by PT Pertamina (Persero) to recognize innovation and continuous improvement programs from all Business Units and Subsidiaries within the Pertamina Group. Carrying the theme “Sustainable Innovation for Nusantara’s Energy Resilience,” this 15th edition is a testament to Pertamina’s ongoing commitment to embedding innovation as a core part of its business practices.

The PC-PROVE WORKSHOP KINGDOM X SOR 2 team showcased an innovation utilizing a gas metering simulator tool (SolMetsos), designed to accelerate the replacement process of a flow computer at the PLN IP Cilegon Gas Station. This solution was developed in response to a gas metering calibration failure in June 2023, when the flow computer was damaged and no spare units were available. With SolMetsos, the replacement process that previously required 30 hours was successfully reduced to just 6 hours, without compromising the reliability of gas distribution to customers.

Sabarrudin, President Director of PGAS Solution, expressed his appreciation for the innovation, stating:

“SolMetsos represents the true synergy between PGAS Solution and SOR 2 in delivering strategic solutions. The dedication and contribution of the field operations team were key to the success of this innovation. We believe SolMetsos will continue to evolve into a core solution for enhancing operational reliability in the future.”

This achievement underscores the shared commitment of PGN Solution and SOR 2 to support digital transformation and enhance the quality of Indonesia’s energy infrastructure. SolMetsos stands as a compelling example that cross-functional collaboration is essential to developing sustainable solutions for Indonesia’s energy resilience.

press-release/bangun-generasi-muda-berka.title: BUILDING A GENERATION OF CHARACTER: PGN SOLUTION’S DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING & DEVELOPMENT VISITS EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS AGAIN
press-release/bangun-generasi-muda-berka.body:

His visit was part of the “Practitioners Teach” event with the theme “Opportunities and Challenges for Engineers in the Oil and Gas Industry”, organized by the Faculty of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering at Syiah Kuala University (USK), Banda Aceh, on Monday (3/2).

Taufiq S., M.Eng., IPU, the Head of the Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering at USK, Prof. Dr. Ir. Syarizal Fonna, ST, M.Sc., IPM, along with the academic community of USK and industry practitioners from Indonesia’s oil and gas sector. During the event, Lebinner shared insights into the oil and gas industry as well as strategies for young people to become resilient and competitive.

In his presentation, Lebinner emphasized that the oil and gas industry plays a strategic role in supporting national economic growth. Therefore, it is crucial for young generations, particularly engineering students, to gain a deep understanding of the opportunities and challenges in this sector.

“PGN Solution is committed to continuously supporting the education sector by sharing knowledge and practical experience with students as future leaders. We aim to build a young generation that not only possesses technical competence but also strong character and a high level of competitiveness on the global stage,” said Lebinner.

PGN Solution’s support for education is not only reflected through seminars or sharing sessions but also through various partnership programs with educational institutions, student internship programs, and corporate social responsibility initiatives focused on education.

On the same occasion, PGN Solution also formalized a collaboration agreement with Syiah Kuala University in the areas of training, research, and technical consulting activities. This Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) serves as a commitment to shaping an outstanding young generation that is ready to face future challenges, particularly benefiting the community in Nanggroe Aceh Darussalam.

press-release/pgn-solution-sukses-rampun.title: PGN SOLUTION SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETES THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE BATANG HO BOOSTER PUMP FOR PT PERTAMINA GAS
press-release/pgn-solution-sukses-rampun.body:
Riau – PGN Solution has once again demonstrated its expertise in the energy infrastructure industry by successfully completing the construction of the Batang HO Booster Pump for PT Pertamina Gas, located in Rokan, Riau. The project was completed ahead of schedule thanks to the implementation of an effective and efficient project management strategy.

In this project, PGN Solution applied the OTOBOSOR principle (On Time, On Budget, On Scope, On Return), ensuring that the project was executed according to the set timeline, budget, and scope while delivering optimal benefits to stakeholders. The Batang HO Booster Pump serves as a key facility in channeling heavy crude oil from the Central Gathering Station (CGS), significantly increasing the flow capacity of crude oil.

The project's success was driven by PGN Solution’s acceleration strategy. By increasing the workforce and implementing a shift system, the project, initially scheduled for completion on May 14, 2025, reached mechanical completion on December 31, 2024—far ahead of the original target.

The project’s location near existing facilities and residential areas added complexity and challenges to the construction process. To ensure smooth project execution and environmental safety, PGN Solution implemented strict project management practices and high technical expertise to avoid disruptions to existing facilities and minimize the impact on the surrounding community. The intensive work pace and complex construction processes also posed unique challenges. However, through solid coordination, the use of modern construction technology, and the high commitment of the field team, the project was executed effectively.

One of the key achievements of this project was the significant increase in crude oil transportation capacity. Previously, the transportation volume was recorded at 32,800 BOPD, but after the project’s completion, the volume surged to 72,000 BOPD. This increase not only supports PT Pertamina Gas’s operations but also strengthens the national energy infrastructure. The successful completion of the Batang HO Booster Pump project further solidifies PGN Solution’s position as a competent and reliable company in the energy infrastructure construction sector. With its experience, expertise, and commitment to quality and efficiency, PGN Solution continues to contribute to the development of the national energy sector.

"We are very grateful that this project was completed ahead of schedule. The OTOBOSOR principle we implemented was key to ensuring that the project was completed on target without compromising safety and work quality. This success would not have been possible without strong teamwork and the support of all parties involved. We hope that this project will provide great benefits to PT Pertamina Gas’s operations and support the national energy infrastructure," said Lebinner Sinaga, Director of Engineering and Development at PGN Solution.

press-release/awali-bulan-k3-nasional-pg.title: STARTING NATIONAL K3 MONTH, PGN SOLUTION HOLDS FREE HEALTH EDUCATION AND VACCINATIONS FOR WORKERS
press-release/awali-bulan-k3-nasional-pg.body:
Jakarta – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) has launched a series of activities to commemorate National K3 Month, including Health Education, Free Influenza Vaccinations, and various other initiatives. These events were held at the Veranda of the External Meeting Room, Building C, PGN Office Complex, West Jakarta, on Monday (13/1).

Sabaruddin, the President Director of PGN Solution, emphasized the importance of activities focused on QHSSE aspects, such as the K3 Month Commemoration, to enhance the implementation of a strong K3 culture within the company. “As we know, workplace safety is our top priority. There is no compromise on this. For this reason, let’s use K3 Month as an opportunity to renew our awareness of health, safety, and security in the work environment,” he stated.

To promote a culture of K3, PGN Solution organized a sharing session for workers with P1 Health Status. P1 represents the highest level of health based on the results of periodic medical check-ups required for employees.

Dr. Andhika Raspati, Sp.KO, a well-known sports medicine specialist and influencer, was also invited as a speaker for the Health Education session titled "Exercise on the Right Track," marking the opening of K3 Month. Dr. Andhika's engaging and humorous presentation added excitement and enthusiasm among PGN Solution employees and directors who participated in the session.

In addition, employees were given the opportunity to receive free influenza vaccinations to strengthen their immune systems, especially during extreme and fluctuating weather conditions.

Immunity can also be boosted through regular exercise. To encourage this habit among employees, PGN Solution inaugurated the "Get Happiness by Walk" competition, a walking challenge where participants compete by accumulating walking distances tracked via the Strava application.

Over the next month, PGN Solution plans to conduct various activities related to QHSSE, including Management Walkthroughs (MWT) of ongoing projects, Process Safety Management training, additional Health Education sessions, and more, all aimed at reinforcing the K3 culture within the PGN Solution work environment.

press-release/pgn-solution-bangun-fasili.title: PGN SOLUTION BUILD EDUCATIONAL FACILITIES AND CLEAN WATER SOURCES, TARGETING TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF COMMUNITY HEALTH AND EDUCATION
press-release/pgn-solution-bangun-fasili.body:
Bogor – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) is holding another program Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), by carrying out the construction of wells as a source of clean water, as well as assistance in improving the quality of education for the community. The social activity was held in Parung Santen RT Village. 003/003, Sukamulya Village, Sukamakmur District, Bogor Regency, West Java on Thursday (17/10).

Also attended by Corporate Secretary PGN Solution, Ris Haryono, The CSR program was held at the Ghoutsul Adhom 165 Islamic Boarding School. An educational institution that exists independently, with minimal financial support from donors. So the boarding school administrators have a little difficulty providing adequate facilities for the students.

Apart from financial constraints, the Islamic boarding school has operational constraints due to the difficulty of getting a clean water supply for bathing, washing, and so on. Until now, residents of the Ghoutsul Adhom 165 Islamic Boarding School meet their water needs by relying on springs where the water is murky and unfit for consumption. Even if the springs are dry, they often rely on rainwater collected in the bathroom roof, to be used as a substitute.

In order to improve the quality of life of Pondok residents, PGN Solution provides assistance in the form of compensation, basic necessities, as well as livestock and their cages, so that they can be bred and provide additional income for Pondok managers. It is hoped that this additional income can be used to build better educational facilities for the students.

Apart from that, the solutionation workers also built wells as a medium for exploiting clean groundwater, as well as establishing a place of study to be used by the santri and female students. This clean water can replace water that is not fit for consumption which is still used by students for their daily needs.

“Education is a pillar of progress. For this reason, it is important for us to continue to give support in order to optimize the function of educational facilities and infrastructure." Reveal Corporate Secretary PGN Solution, Ris Haryono.

press-release/sambut-semarak-energi-terb.title: WELCOMING THE SPIRIT OF RENEWABLE ENERGY, PGN SOLUTION & PERTAMINA GEOTHERMAL ENERGY REVIEW GEOTHERMAL ENERGY PROJECT STRATEGIES
press-release/sambut-semarak-energi-terb.body:
Jakarta – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) together with PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy (PGE) are again holding a series of collaborations to develop geothermal energy projects. A series of collaborations in the form of an inauguration Joint Development Agreement This begins the process of studying Geothermal EPC and Pipeline Construction, which will later become a reference in construction and development projects for geothermal energy instruments. The signing was also witnessed by Director of Geothermal Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Gigih Udi Atmo, and Deputy Minister for Investment Planning, Ministry of Investment/BKPM RI, Dedi Latip.

The event was held to coincide with Indonesia International Geothermal Convention & Exhibition (IIGCE), which took place at the Jakarta Convention Center, Senayan, Central Jakarta on Thursday (19/9).

IIGCE itself is an international geothermal energy fair that brings together business actors in the geothermal energy sector, in order to spur synergistic and innovative cooperation in the field of geothermal energy. geothermal, as an alternative transition energy. This event starts on 18 – 20 September 2024, and is also attended by the President of the Republic of Indonesia, along with other relevant government officials.

“We really appreciate this collaboration. A strategic collaboration with a very visionary goal. Similar to natural gas, geothermal energy is a reliable, environmentally friendly green energy. The potential is huge, but the challenges in terms of accessibility and affordability are also quite complex. However, we are here ready to move forward. We are very sure of everything obstacle can be faced through synergistic cooperation." Said PGN Solution's Director of Finance and Business Support, Ariadi.

Geothermal energy is one alternative energy that can be relied upon in the energy transition period. This energy source without greenhouse gas and carbon emissions is also believed to be able to minimize the impact of environmental pollution which has a negative impact on public health.

As a company that is active in the realm of energy infrastructure development, PGN Solution will continue to open the door to collaboration for all parties in order to pioneer sustainable synergy in expanding the energy network, especially environmentally friendly green energy so that it can be enjoyed equally by the Indonesian people.

press-release/sinergi-kepedulian-pgn-sol.title: SYNERGY OF CARE, PGN SOLUTION SUPPORTS PERTAMINA TO GAIN THE KNOWLEDGE OF THE NATION’S SUCCESSORS
press-release/sinergi-kepedulian-pgn-sol.body:
PT Pertamina (Persero), through PGN Solution, is again holding Pertamina Energi Negeri (PEN) 7.0 as a superior social education program. The program was held at SD Negeri Sukadamai 3, Bogor City and SD Negeri Ciawi, Jatinangor, West Java on Monday (26/08), and is a concrete manifestation of Pertamina's commitment in spreading knowledge and the culture of volunteerism to company officers.

Carrying the theme "ARUTALA," which comes from Sanskrit and means "High and Noble Ideals," this activity provides an opportunity for PGN Solution Officers to share inspiration, open insight, and nurture children's dreams so that they will always be tough and brave. in achieving goals. With this spirit, Pertamina hopes to build the next generation who dare to dream big and have a strong foundation to achieve their life goals.

"We would like to express our deepest appreciation to the teachers of SD Negeri Sukadam 3 and SD Negeri Ciawi Jatinangor who have welcomed the presence of the Pertamina Energi Negeri (PEN) volunteer team. We hope that the knowledge that has been conveyed by the volunteers will be a valuable provision for the students. students in achieving a brilliant future," said PGN Solution Volunteer representative, Emil Andi Rahman.

The PEN 7.0 program is not only inspiring, but also carries a social mission to improve educational facilities and infrastructure at Sukadam 3 State Elementary School and Ciawi State Elementary School, Jatinangor. As part of this activity, PGN Solution provided assistance in the form of facilities and infrastructure to support teaching and learning activities, school waste bins, souvenirs and souvenirs for students.

The activity began with a flag ceremony at 07.00 to 08.00 WIB, and continued with the entry of teaching volunteers into each designated class. On this occasion, the volunteers provided educational material covering Pertamina's business processes, implementation of AKHLAK Values, anti-bullying movements, and instilling the spirit of independence of the Republic of Indonesia.

“Character education is the basis for developing the knowledge of our young generation. "For this reason, we are proud and enthusiastic to be able to introduce AKHLAK values ​​to students, while introducing them to the world of energy." Said Corporate Secretary PGN Solution, Ris Haryono.

PGN Solution believes that investment in the education aspect is a long-term investment that has a positive impact on the growth of the nation's next generation. With high enthusiasm, Pertamina and PGN Solution are committed to continuing to support the world of education and inspiring Indonesia's young generation.

press-release/buktikan-komitmen-budaya-k.body:
Bali – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) has once again made brilliant achievements in the field Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) at 1st OHS Asia's Summit Conference 2024. The event, which was held to promote K3 cultural practices, was held at the Prama Hotel, Sanur, Bali Province on 22-23 August 2024.

With the theme “OSH Culture Maturity Development Toward Business Excellence Sustainability”, OSH Asia's Summit 2024 was also attended by participants from various countries and industrial backgrounds. At this event, PGN Solution had the opportunity to become an award participating company, and went through a series of interview and judging processes.

From the panel and interview process, PGN Solution succeeded in winning the nomination “The Best OSH in Oil & Gas Category”, “Excellence in Safety Application Program”, and “The Best Program in Conscientious Effort in Maintaining Safety with Zero Accident Goals”. These three awards have become a reflection of PGN Solution's commitment to its consistency in making HSSE a necessity for business sustainability.

PGN Solution Operations Director, Aldiansyah Idham and Head of PGN Solution QHSSE Division, Astrid Taruli Debora were present to represent PGN Solution at the moment of giving the award. "In our office there is a small mural that says 'Care for the Environment and Surroundings'. A small reminder with a big impact. A reminder to all workers that all individuals are responsible for security and safety aspects in the work environment. I hope that this understanding can always be embedded not only for workers in our work environment, but also for workers everywhere and in any industry. May safety always be with us all." Said Astrid Taruli Debora.

Apart from being an event to give appreciation to companies that are pioneers in implementing work safety aspects, OSH Asia's Summit 2024 is also a momentum to strengthen commitment to work safety standards in order to build a healthier and safer industrial future throughout Asia.

As a company active in the realm of energy infrastructure management, PGN Solution is committed to prioritizing HSSE values ​​in all its operational activities. As stated by the Director of Operations at PGN Solution, Aldiansyah Idham, "Our company operates in the energy infrastructure sector, so we are used to managing large-scale energy instruments. For this reason, we fully understand how essential the safety aspect is in each of our operational activities. I hope this award can serve as a reminder. A reminder for us, or for all of us, to always maintain and even improve the quality of safety standards, in order to make it happen zero accident in every operational activity.” he said.

press-release/awali-sinergi-berkelanjuta.body:
Jakarta – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) held a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signing event with PT Mandiri Migas Pratama Kaltim (MMP Kaltim) on Friday (16/8). The agreement under the memorandum of understanding covers the fields Engineering, Procurement, and Construction, Operation & Maintenance, Supply Chain,and Manpower Supply in the field of oil and natural gas.

Taking place in the External Meeting Room Building C, PGN Head Office, West Jakarta, this event was also attended by the Director of Strategy and Business Development of PGN, along with the entire board of directors of PGN Solution and MMP Kaltim.

In her speech, PGN's Director of Strategy and Business Development, Rosa Permata Sari, expressed her hope for the contribution of both parties to take part in the oil and gas and renewable energy industry. "Currently Pertamina, especially in East Kalimantan, is not only focusing on its business in the carbon realm, but also its stream business in upstream energy. So the hope is that this synergy will not only move for carbon businesses, but how can the concept of MMP and PGASOL bring renewable energy.”

It is hoped that this collaboration can increase the movement for energy network development, especially in the East Kalimantan region and its surroundings. Both parties hope to be able to unite their common vision and goals, in order to optimize the results of cooperation that will take place on an ongoing basis.

“In fact, East Kalimantan is our home too. There, we have built the Senipah - Balikpapan gas pipeline network, as well as an Air Refueling Depot. Apart from that, it is hoped that this collaboration can be initiated for several project such as EPC, O&M, Supply Chain, as well as pipe infrastructure work offshore. "Through this collaboration, we will also expand the reach of other types of work, including renewable energy," said PGN Solution President Director Sabaruddin.

On the same occasion, the Main Director of MMP Kaltim, Edy Kurniawan, expressed his appreciation and hope for the collaboration that has officially been established. “Today I am very grateful to PGN and PGN Solution. With the signing of this MoU, hopefully we can increase our competence and portfolio in our work as an energy network management company. Like PGN Solution, we at MMP Kaltim always carry out business activities with a commitment to good corporate governance in order to carry out healthy business activities," he said.

press-release/sinergi-dalam-transisi-ene.body:
Jakarta – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) is officially the part of the Joint Study Geothermal Center of Excellence organized by PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk. (PGE), through Joint Study Agreement (JSA) signing on Thursday (27/6).

For this reason, I really appreciate this full synergy of benefits. "We (PGN Solution) will continue to be optimistic and provide support for the country regarding innovation in aspects of the national energy transition, and one of them is through this joint study." "Concluded the Main Director of PGN Solution, Sabaruddin."

press-release/sambut-idul-adha-1445-hijr.body:
Jakarta – In commemoration of Eid al-Adha 1445 H, PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) distributed 238 sacrificial animals throughout the work area on Monday (17/6). The total number consists of 31 cows and 207 goats.

The distribution of sacrificial meat is PGN Solution's annual routine, as a form of concern for the communities around its operational areas. This activity was carried out in order to implement corporate social responsibility (CSR), as well as to increase the value of mutual cooperation between fellow workers.

President Director of PGN Solution, Sabaruddin said that Eid al-Adha is a momentum to achieve blessings. “Let's see this activity as a more important moment than just distributing meat. With the great blessings behind this activity, we ask for Allah SWT's mercy for blessings and safety for all of us as one big family. "May Allah SWT always protect and guide us all in serving society," he said.

Sacrificial meat that has been sorted and packaged has been distributed to communities around several PGN Solution operational areas. Among them are Daan Mogot, Klender, Cilegon, Tangerang, Bekasi, Karawang, Bogor, Cirebon, Lampung, Palembang, Surabaya, Pasuruan, Sidoarjo, Semarang, Medan, Batam, Riau, Sorong, Sulawesi, Aceh and Kalimantan Gas Network Areas.

"Appreciation for the high enthusiasm should be given to the entire sacrificial meat distribution committee who were on duty. It is with the hard work of these colleagues that PGN Solution can become closer and more integrated in society and spread blessings to them. "Hopefully this splendor of blessings can always reap benefits and blessings for all parties involved," said PGN Solution Operations Director, Aldiansyah Idham.

press-release/komitmen-ciptakan-proyek-a.title: COMMITTED TO CREATE RELIABLE, SAFE AND SAFE PROJECTS, PGN SOLUTION AND PERTAMINA PATRA NIAGA HELD A MANAGEMENT WALKTHROUGH OF PENGAPON - BOYOLALI PIPING
press-release/komitmen-ciptakan-proyek-a.body:
Salatiga – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) again carried out a Management Walkthrough (MWT) on the Pengapon – Boyolali pipeline project on Thursday (30/5), as a form of joint commitment between Pertamina Patra Niaga as the project owner, and PGN Solution as the construction contractor. This activity was held at the Pertamina Patra Niaga pipeline project site which started in June 2023.

This activity was also attended by the Director of Planning & Business Development of Pertamina Patra Niaga, Harsono Budi Santoso, the Director of Engineering and Development of PGN Solution, Lebinner Sinaga, along with all ranks and heads of work units within the scope of the Pengapon - Boyolali Pipeline Project.

“This activity is carried out to minimize all risks. Risks from aspects of work safety, technical workmanship and so on to minimize the occurrence of human error or other things that we don't want. For this reason, let us carry it out with awareness of this." Harsono said.

Holding MWT inspections is a form of the company's commitment to implementing aspects of security, safety, health and the effectiveness of project work to create optimal work results.

Starting this activity, the Board of Directors and staff from Pertamina Patra Niaga and PGN Solution made a project progress presentation at the Boyolali Fuel Oil Terminal (TBBM) owned by Pertamina Patra Niaga. After that, the MWT activities continued with a visit to the Auger Boring work at Kilometer Point (KP) 9, and then ended with a visit and observation of the Mainlane Right of Way (ROW) work at Kilometer Point 17.

The Pengapon – Boyolali Pipeline Project itself is a project to construct a pipeline to distribute Pertamina's fuel products with a length of 81.5 kilometers. The aim of this project is to maintain the resilience of the fuel supply and increase the economic efficiency of fuel, by reducing the cost of transporting the fuel itself.

"This synergistic project is a big responsibility of PGN Solution as a contractor, as a liaison between the community and the benefits of energy. press-release/melalui-program-csr-pgn-so.title: THROUGH THE CSR PROGRAM, PGN SOLUTION DISTRIBUTES AID TO DEMAK - KUDUS FLOOD VICTIMS
press-release/melalui-program-csr-pgn-so.body:
Demak – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) through the Semarang Area Representative Office visited the evacuation posts for Demak - Kudus flood victims, at the JHK Kudus Building and SDN 1 Gajah Demak, Demak Regency, Central Java on Friday (22/3).

The number of residents affected by the flood disaster in these two areas is estimated to reach more than 30,000 people.

“We understand and can feel the wounds suffered by the victims. We hope that the assistance we provide will be useful and give them a little strength. "We at PGASOL will always monitor the latest conditions and pray for the affected residents, so that they will always be given strength and fortitude in facing this disaster." press-release/jalin-kolaborasi-sinergis-.title: ESTABLISHING SYNERGIC COLLABORATION, PGN SOLUTION AND LEMIGAS INAUGURATE COOPERATION IN THE OIL & GAS FIELD
press-release/jalin-kolaborasi-sinergis-.body:
Jakarta – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) and the LEMIGAS Oil and Gas Testing Center signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) as a form of inauguration of cooperation in the aspects of Testing, Calibration and Procurement of Goods and other Services in the oil and gas sector, as well as utilization of oil and gas laboratory facilities. This collaboration is also expected to increase awareness of the importance of implementing Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE) aspects in every project work, in order to create a safe and secure work environment.

Located at the Office of the Directorate General of Oil and Gas, Jl. HR Rasuna Said, Kuningan, South Jakarta on Monday (25/3), the signing of the MOU was attended by the Directorate General of Oil and Gas, Head of LEMIGAS, Main Director of PGN, Main Director of PGN Solution, and all directors and management of PGN, PGN Solution, and PT Solusi Energi Nusantara (SENA).

The signing of this MoU is an effort by both parties to increase business cooperation, worker competence and expertise. PGN Solution and LEMIGAS will continue to improve operational quality through exchanging information and knowledge, holding workshops, seminars and other activities related to oil and natural gas.

"I hope that this activity can be carried out well and correctly by paying attention to Schedule, Cost and Quality values. The schedule must be on time, costs must not be exceeded, and quality must be carefully considered so that the benefits produced are more optimal. "Because if we are observant, this collaboration is a huge opportunity to reap many benefits." Said the Director General of Oil and Gas, Prof. Ir. Tutuka Ariadji, MSc, PHD.

Apart from that, the Main Director of Pertamina Gas Negara, Arief Setiawan Handoko, also said, "It is hoped that this collaboration between PGASOL and LEMIGAS will be a 'Palugada' collaboration. We can see that the contents of the cooperation written in today's MoU will be implemented in various fields. Starting from testing, calibration, procurement of goods and services, certification, knowledge sharing, workshops, and so on. It's truly an 'anything goes' collaboration. The synergy is extraordinary, and I am sure it can reap benefits for the nation and state."

A number of oil and gas projects that have been carried out by PGN Solution include the Tambak Lorok Offtake Station, construction of household gas lines in Wajo Regency and Banggai Regency, Replacement of the Rokan WK Oil Pipeline, Pengapon - Boyolali Oil Pipeline and development of natural gas infrastructure in the Kendal Industrial Area (KIK) - Mangkang & Batang Integrated Industrial Area (KIT).

The signing of a memorandum of understanding by both parties has become the green light for the start of a series of synergistic activities between PGN Solution and LEMIGAS over the next 3 years, in order to increase excellence in responding to the energy needs of society by prioritizing work skills and safety.

From the aspect of work safety, PGN Solution is a company operating in the EPC, O&M and Supply Chain sectors with a wide work area spread so it has high work risks. Therefore, for PGN Solution, implementing HSSE is the key to the Company's business sustainability which needs special attention.

PGASOL is committed to implementing HSSE aspects as a whole in the PGAS Sol work environment by implementing the ISO 45001:2018, ISO 14001, and SMK3 PP 50/2012 Integration Management System. During the work, PGASOL achieved 14,381,170 safe working hours.

"Furthermore, PGASOL provides competent resources, increases competence through training & certification, provides appropriate equipment, and so on. Apart from that, PGASOL as a contractor always fulfills the HSSE program and procedures determined by the client. To ensure that the HSSE program is carried out, the K3PL and PGASOL Security Divisions carry out periodic monitoring and audits. "Management also reviews the work and implementation of HSSE regularly," explained Sabaruddin.

press-release/perkuat-ketahanan-energi-d.title: STRENGTHENING ENERGY SECURITY IN CENTRAL JAVA, THE SYNERGY OF PERTAMINA GAS SUBHOLDING AND C&T SUBHOLDING BUILDS THE PENGAPON-BOYOLALI OIL PIPELINE PROJECT
press-release/perkuat-ketahanan-energi-d.body:
Boyolali – Pertamina Gas Subholding through its subsidiary PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) together with PT Pertamina Patra Niaga carried out First Welding of the Pengapon - Boyolali Oil Pipeline Project for energy supply in Central Java. The first welding was carried out at KP 02 Pipanisasi Pengapon Boyolali, Central Java on Thursday (12/10/2023). At the first welding were present the Regent of Boyolali, Director of Technology & Infrastructure PGN, Director of Infrastructure Pertamina Patra Niaga, Main Director of PGN Solution, Director of Engineering and Development of PGN Solution, Boyolali Police Chief, Boyolali Dandim and Head of Boyolali District Prosecutor's Office.

Assistant 2 for Economics and Development, Insan Adi Asmono, representing the Regent of Boyolali welcomed the construction of the Pengapon - Boyolali oil pipeline and hoped that it would benefit the community. "The hope is that this project can run smoothly so that fuel stocks can be guaranteed and can be of benefit to the community, especially in Boyolali. Hopefully there will be no obstacles in implementing this development. In principle, the Boyolali Regional Government fully supports every National Strategic Project running in its area." said Insan Adi Asmono.

The construction of a steel pipe measuring ± 81.5 kilometers long with a diameter of 12 inches will be used for energy continuity in the Central Java region through the distribution of fuel oil (BBM) such as Premium, Solar, Pertamax, from the Integrated Terminal Semarang Group (Pengapon) to the Boyolali Fuel Terminal .

"We appreciate PGN Solution for implementing capabilities in terms of energy infrastructure construction. We hope that pipe reliability will always be prioritized, because this pipe is to meet the fuel needs in Boyolali. "Collaboration with Pertamina Patra Niaga is also a form of synergy between Pertamina Subholdings and this must be improved in the future," said PGN's Director of Infrastructure and Technology, Achmad Muchtasyar.

He hopes that the fuel pipeline built by PGN Solution will help to accommodate safe fuel stocks for the people of Boyolali. This oil pipeline project is a pipeline to distribute fuel products which can reduce distribution costs and is a real effort to implement Environmental Social Governance (ESG) in helping reduce carbon emissions, where previously fuel distribution used ships and trucks.

"The Pengapon Boyolali Pipeline Project intends to install a pipeline to distribute fuel products, so as to maintain the resilience of fuel stocks and prevent potential supply failures, especially for gasoline products in the Central Java region. We hope that this development can run smoothly so that it can immediately be used to fulfill energy needs in the Central Java region." added Pertamina Patra Niaga Infrastructure Director, Edward Adolf Kawi.

Sabaruddin, Main Director of PGN Solution, said that the construction of the pipeline from Pengapon to Boyolali will cross several areas, including Semarang Regency, Mranggen to Kedoya Semarang. "PGN Solution will be committed to supporting Pertamina Patra Niaga in energy supply in Central Java by building pipeline infrastructure which is expected to run on time, on budget and on quality and fulfill safety, social and environmental sustainability aspects," continued Sabaruddin.

In the construction of this pipe, apart from the engineering and technical aspects that must be prepared, PGN Solution also focuses on social and licensing aspects through coordination with other stakeholders in the areas that are the development route. "With First Welding, of course we expect full support from all stakeholders, so that all stages of the pipeline construction process can run well and smoothly, so that it can immediately be used to fulfill energy needs in the Central Java region," concluded Sabaruddin.

press-release/dukung-kebutuhan-bbm-jawa-.title: SUPPORTING CENTRAL JAVA'S FUEL NEEDS, PGN SOLUTION BUILDS PERTAMINA PENGAPON BOYOLALI PIPELINE
press-release/dukung-kebutuhan-bbm-jawa-.body:
Jakarta – PT PGAS Solution (PGN Solution) had the opportunity to collaborate with PT Pertamina Patra Niaga and held a Coordination Meeting for Preparation for Implementation of the Pengapon Boyolali Pipeline Work which was held at JS Luwansa Hotel Jakarta (19/6). The event was attended by PGN Solution Main Director Sabaruddin, PGN Solution Engineering & Development Director Lebinner Sinaga, PGN Solution Operations Director Aldiansyah Idham, PGN Solution Finance & Business Support Director Ariadi, Pertamina Patra Niaga Land Engineering and Infrastructure Director Eduward Adolof Kawi, as well as Management from both sides.

Through a letter appointing the winner of the Pengapon Boyolali Pipeline work No. 252/PNG230000/2023-S7 dated 16 May 2023 from PT Pertamina Patra Niaga, PGN Solution became the winner of the open tender. Where PGN Solution follows all processes and prepares everything required by the Employer. In the appointment letter, PGN Solution is stated as the executor, with the name Pengapon Boyolali Pipeline Works with a work value of around 570 billion Rupiah. In this work, PT Pertamina Patra Niaga, through the Directorate of Land Engineering and Infrastructure, intends to build a new pipeline that can distribute BBM or Gasoline products from the Semarang Group BBM Terminal (Pengapon) to the Boyolali BBM Terminal.

In order to prepare for the resilience of fuel needs in Boyolali and its surroundings, as well as the Central Java region. The project location is a ROW (Right of Way) route with a 12 inch diameter steel pipe measuring ± 81.5 kilometers which will cross several areas of Semarang Regency, Mranggen to Kedoya Semarang. "The construction of the Pengapon Boyolali Pipeline was carried out using a Tie-In (connecting) process from the old Pertamina Pipeline CY-III line and the Pertagas ROW, where for security the pipeline is equipped with an ESDV Section, Block Valve Station and other operational support equipment. This work is being carried out with a target time of approximately 24 months." Said Lebinner Sinaga, Director of Engineering and Development at PGN Solution.

Previously, sending fuel products used sea routes, which required quite a long time and large costs, with the construction of the Pengapon Boyolali pipeline, it can reduce freight costs (transportation costs) for ship modes for gas oil products from RU (Refinery). Unit) IV Cilacap to Pengapon BBM Terminal. Apart from that, it also reduces Jetty Occupancy at the RU (Refinery Unit) IV Cilacap pier by diverting Gasoline supply injection from TBBM Lomanis to TBBM Pengapon. Sabaruddin said, "PGN Solution is committed to this pipeline construction work, apart from being able to maintain fuel stocks and preventing potential supply failures from Pengapon to Boyolali, fuel needs can also be distributed smoothly to areas around Central Java.

"Therefore, PGN Solution is proud to contribute to the development of the country through the Pengapon Boyolali Pipeline Work." The Boyolali – Pengapon pipeline project is a form of synergy in the distribution of real good energy and can have a positive impact on the development of the Central Java region.

“HIV/AIDS cannot yet be cured, but we can reduce the amount of virus in the blood with treatment. The way to detect HIV/AIDS can be done through blood tests. HIV/AIDS cannot be transmitted by sharing a house with an infected person, swimming, shaking hands, eating together, hugging, or mosquito/insect bites," said Dr. Serla as a doctor at the Taman Sari District Health Center. In Indonesia, there is still a lot of stigma and discrimination against HIV/AIDS sufferers, this can slow down HIV testing, hide the status of reactive test results, and not seek HIV services, thereby hampering treatment for sufferers.

Head of PGN Solution's K3PL and Security Division, Santi Hairunissa, said, "This activity has been routinely carried out by PGN Solution for 8 years. PGN Solution is committed to prevent the spread of HIV/AIDS in the company and there is no discrimination against PLWHA and PLHIV. It is hoped that this activity can support the three zero program. "In addition to health education on preventing and controlling HIV AIDS and Covid-19, several examinations include screening for TB, Covid-19, cervical cancer and non-communicable diseases for 100 workers.

This HIV/AIDS examination has the aim of preventing HIV/AIDS so that can create a work environment that is safe, healthy and protected from HIV/AIDS. Apart from that, there are other tests besides HIV such as TB and Cervical Cancer." Concluded Santi Hairunissa.

press-release/pgn-solution-salurkan-ener.title: PGN SOLUTION DISTRIBUTES REAL GOOD ENERGY TO JABODETABEK FLOOD VICTIMS
press-release/pgn-solution-salurkan-ener.body:
Jakarta, January 3rd 2020 -- Heavy rains engulfing Jakarta and surrounding areas since Tuesday (13/12) caused floods in numerous areas. Based on monitors by the National Natural Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), floods are recorded in 169 spots in Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, Bekasi and Banten.

As a form of concern towards the environment as well as people in surrounding areas, as well as a form of implementing Corporate Social Responsibility, PT PGAS Solution has actively taken action in relieving the burden of flood victims. Starting Tuesday evening (2/1) until today (3/1) has continuously distributed support to flood victims in four areas including Jakarta with four emergency posts, 9 posts in Bekasi, 6 posts in Tangerang, and 1 post in Bogor.

The total value of assistance distributed reached 200 million Rupiah. As for assistance distributed such as staple materials, instant noodles, biscuits, clean water, medicines, food and clothing necessities, as well as safety and evacuation for victims trapped in floods. CSR action taken by PT PGAS Solution team together with CSR from PT PGN and supported by Indonesian National Armed Forces Transportation Unit of the Land Forces of BatuJajar Depok ensured assistance was delivered swiftly and right on target.

In addition to providing assistance, PGASOL Team has also assisted the evacuation process of PGN Group employees who were caught in the flood. Until early in the morning, PGASOL team together with PGN CSR team were on the ready and standby anytime to assist flood victims.

Chaedar, acting Chief Director of PT PGAS Solution stated: “ PT PGAS Solution needs to be empathetic and united, as the “team work” culture in SOLUTION culture. Helping each other, completing each other, supporting each other, not only internally but towards those who are impacted by the flood. This is the true meaning of sharing GOOD ENERGY in its best.”

This is demonstrated by using Bekasi and Tangerang offices to serve as PGN Group Emergency posts. It enables PT PGAS Solution to be truly present in sharing Good Energy, not only to its workers but also the surrounding community who are flood victims.

PT PGAS Solution team is always ready and standing by to support even after the flood disaster. “We hope that the assistance provided relief for flood victims, and we also hope the flood may be resolved soon,” ended Ris Haryono, acting Company Secretary of PT PGAS Solution.

press-release/pisah-sambut-dan-serah-ter.body:
Jakarta, February 7th 2020 -- Today, Friday February 7th 2020, a farewell, welcoming and handover event of President Director is held at PT PGAS Solution 2nd floor Coworking Space. The event attended by the entire Board of Directors, Division Heads, Employees and esteemed guests. This occasion was opened with a welcoming speech by Chaedar, he shared his moments and last message as President Director of PT PGAS Solution, then followed with a speech by Erwin Simanjutak as the new President Director.

Chaedar has served as President Director for two years, 2018 to 2020. Previously, he served as Financial Director PT PGAS Solution in 2015 to 2018, and now Erwin Simanjuntak is entrusted as President Director of PT PGAS Solution based Circulair Resolution by the Shareholders (KPSSS) on February 5th, 2020.

“What I always instill to everyone of you is that when we are together, we are able and responsible. It is impossible to take action without being responsible. Once we’ve taken a step, we have to take responsibility and finish ongoing projects,” shared Chaedar in his speech at the farewell and welcoming event for PT PGAS Solution President Director.

Chaedar also advised the board of Directors: “Take care of them like family. When there are mistakes, then we have to guide them because we are a leader, because we are family, Solutionation family.”

In January, shareholders have also issued a KPSSS with changes in the board of Directors. Director of Engineering and Development is being replaced with Rangga Radji, previously Tatit Sri Jayendra served as Director of Operations is now being replaced with Edi Armawiria, and Director of Finance and Administration previously was Taryaka, and has been replaced with Ariadi.

press-release/peduli-terhadap-kemandiria.title: PT PGAS SOLUTION HELD A NATIONAL SEMINAR: FOSTERING SELF RELIANT COMMUNITY WITH A K3 (OPERATIONAL SAFETY & HEALTH) CULTURE
press-release/peduli-terhadap-kemandiria.body:
Jakarta, February 11th, 2020 – Today, Tuesday February 11th 2020, a HSSE Seminar was held by PT PGAS Solution as part of the National Operational Safety & Health Month at Luminor Hotel, Pecenongan, Jakarta. The theme was “Optimizing Self Reliant Communities with a K3 Culture in a Revolutionary Era Industry 4.0 Information Technology based”. In 2019, PT PGAS Solution has also successfully held a K3 Seminar commemorating The National Operational Safety & Health Month themed Industrial Hygiene.

This event was attended by the Supervising Director of K3 Norm from the Indonesian Ministry of Labor, Director of Water Quality Monitoring from the Indonesian Ministry of Environment & Forestry, HSSE PT PGN Tbk Head Division , HSSE Division PT PGAS Solution and invitees of HSSE associates. The theme in the 2020 seminar this time is to remind all of us that today’s industry is moving in alignment with the growth of technology towards revolutionary industry 4.0. With cutting edge technology today, we are able to make use every means necessary to continuously improve HSSE culture in the company.

At exactly 08.00 am Indonesian time, the event opened by welcoming key speakers and followed by PT PGAS Solution launching one of its innovative products as a form of PT PGAS Solutions commitment towards environmental sustainability.

The tool works to detect the quality of water waste linked to a report system sent to the Ministry of Environment, such that water waste that eventually will be flown to the river will meet environmental quality standards. A tool that has five sensors that are able to detect pH, Total Solid Suspended, Chemical Oxygen Demand, Flowmeter, and Ammonia Nitrogent is called SOLWATY. SOLWATY has also passed a connectivity test with the Ministry of Environment.

Santi Hairunissa as HSSE Head Division states: “With this event, we wish that implementation and concerns about the environment becomes our responsibility, not only the responsibility between companies, but working together to implement this as a form of concern towards the environment as a whole.”

“This event is important in order to build relations and communications between PT PGAS Solutions and its Stakeholders. This courtesy and unity is needed to maintain a good synergy”, added Ris Haryono, PT PGAS Solution Company Secretary.
